visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with pigtails wearing a black and white striped shirt stands on a concrete driveway near a red SUV. A brown dog enters the frame from the right side and approaches her. (2) The girl turns and runs excitedly towards a backyard garden area where an older woman in a checkered shirt and an older man are waiting. They embrace in a warm group hug on a grassy lawn. (3) A younger man wearing glasses and a gray t-shirt holds a young girl in his arms outdoors. He is smiling and talking directly to the child. (4) The scene shifts to a dark indoor living room. A round chocolate cake decorated with fruit and a single lit candle sits on a wooden table. Two small children are seated at the table watching the candle. (5) A close-up shot shows a young girl with pigtails; she has her eyes closed and her hands clasped together in a prayer-like wish gesture in front of the cake. (6) Three children lean in close to the lit candle and blow together to extinguish it. The room is dark, illuminated primarily by the candle's glow. (7) In a brightly lit kitchen and dining area, the girl in the striped shirt points at the birthday cake on the table while an adult's hand reaches in. (8) A younger toddler claps her hands excitedly while sitting in a high chair, smiling broadly at the camera in the well-lit room.
